interscalene.name: Gây tê đám rối thần kinh cánh tay đường liên cơ bậc thang
interscalene.targetNerve: Rễ C5–C7 của đám rối thần kinh cánh tay
indications: Clavicle surgery (combined with superficial cervical plexus)
sparedNerves: Ulnar nerve (inferior trunk) — not suitable for hand surgery
sideEffects: Ipsilateral phrenic nerve block — 100% incidence (avoid in severe respiratory disease)
Rare: pneumothorax, vertebral artery injection, epidural/intrathecal spread
technique: Patient semi-sitting, head turned away
Linear high-frequency US probe transverse at C6 level (between anterior and middle scalene)
Identify plexus "traffic light" appearance (3 hypoechoic nerve roots)
In-plane needle approach, posterior to anterior
Inject between C5-C6 nerve roots, hydro-dissecting the sheath
interscalene.duration: 6–12 h (single shot); continuous up to 72 h

supraclavicular.name: Gây tê đám rối thần kinh cánh tay đường trên đòn
supraclavicular.targetNerve: Phân chia đám rối thần kinh cánh tay (phía trên xương đòn)
supraclavicular.coverage: Toàn bộ chi trên ngoại trừ da trên vai
sideEffects: Pneumothorax (classic risk — now reduced with US guidance but still possible)
Phrenic nerve block (50% with US; much higher with landmark)
technique: Supine, head turned away
US probe in supraclavicular fossa, behind mid-clavicle
Identify subclavian artery, first rib, pleura
In-plane needle approach, lateral to medial
Target "corner pocket" — lateral to artery, superior to first rib

infraclavicular.name: Gây tê đám rối thần kinh cánh tay đường dưới đòn
infraclavicular.targetNerve: Dây đám rối thần kinh cánh tay (dưới xương đòn)
sideEffects: No phrenic nerve involvement (preferred over supraclavicular in respiratory disease)
technique: Supine, arm abducted 90°
US probe parasagittal, medial to coracoid process
Identify axillary artery with 3 cords (lateral, posterior, medial)
In-plane needle approach, cephalad to caudal
Inject posterior to artery (U-shape spread)

axillary.name: Gây tê đám rối thần kinh cánh tay đường nách
axillary.targetNerve: Các nhánh cuối (giữa, trụ, xuyên tâm, cơ da)
sideEffects: Incomplete block (musculocutaneous often missed — needs separate injection)
technique: Supine, arm abducted and externally rotated
US probe transverse in axilla
Identify axillary artery, surround nerves
Inject separately around each nerve (median superficial, ulnar inferior, radial posterior to artery)
Musculocutaneous in coracobrachialis muscle — separate injection

femoral.name: Gây tê dây thần kinh đùi
indications: Knee surgery (ACL, TKA — combined with sciatic/adductor canal)
femoral.coverage: Đùi trước, chân trong (dây thần kinh hiển), bao khớp gối
sideEffects: Quadriceps weakness — fall risk in ambulatory patients
Rarely: nerve injury with direct needle trauma
technique: Supine, leg slightly abducted
US probe transverse in inguinal crease
Identify femoral artery → nerve lateral to it, under fascia iliaca
In-plane needle, lateral to medial
Inject under fascia iliaca, nerve rolls and floats

adductor-canal.name: Gây tê ống cơ khép
adductor-canal.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh hiển + dây thần kinh đến cơ rộng trong (trong ống dẫn)
indications: TKA / knee arthroscopy — preserves quadriceps strength
Preferred over femoral block for ambulatory knee surgery
advantages: Preserves quadriceps motor function (enabling early mobilization after TKA)
Reduced fall risk compared to femoral block
sideEffects: Rarely: vascular puncture (femoral artery at apex of canal)
technique: Supine, leg externally rotated
US probe transverse at mid-thigh (midway between ASIS and patella)
Identify sartorius muscle, femoral artery deep to it
Target fascia around artery (under sartorius)
In-plane needle, lateral to medial, 15–20 mL

fascia-iliaca.name: Gây tê khoang mạc chậu
fascia-iliaca.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh bì đùi + ngoài xương đùi ± dây thần kinh bịt
technique: Supine, leg extended
US probe transverse in inguinal region, medial to ASIS
Identify fascia iliaca as hyperechoic line over iliacus muscle
In-plane needle, lateral to medial approach
Pop through fascia iliaca, inject 30 mL — spread seen under fascia
Can be done as "suprainguinal" approach for better obturator coverage

sciatic.name: Gây tê thần kinh tọa đường khoeo
sciatic.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh tọa (L4–S3) — xương chày + mác chung
indications: Combined with saphenous/adductor canal for complete below-knee coverage
technique: Prone or lateral (leg up)
US probe transverse in popliteal fossa
Identify popliteal artery → tibial nerve above it, common peroneal lateral
Target the nerve BEFORE bifurcation (4–6 cm proximal to popliteal crease)
In-plane needle, lateral approach

ankle-block.name: Gây tê vùng cổ chân
ankle-block.targetNerve: 5 dây thần kinh: chày sau, mác sâu, mác nông, nông, hiển
sideEffects: Inadequate surgical anaesthesia if any nerve missed
technique: Landmark + US guidance for tibial and deep peroneal
Infiltration technique for superficial nerves
Avoid tourniquet pain with concurrent calf infiltration or light sedation

tap.name: Gây tê mặt phẳng cơ ngang bụng (TAP block)
tap.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh ngực bụng T7–L1 (trong TAP giữa cơ chéo trong và cơ ngang)
indications: Lower abdominal surgery (below umbilicus): hernia, C-section, hysterectomy
tap.coverage: Chỉ thành bụng cơ thể (KHÔNG che phủ nội tạng)
sideEffects: ⚠ Large volumes (30–40 mL bilateral) → high plasma LA levels; risk of LAST
technique: Supine, arms by side
US probe transverse in mid-axillary line, between costal margin and iliac crest
Identify 3 muscle layers: external oblique, internal oblique, transversus abdominis
Target plane BETWEEN internal oblique and transversus abdominis
In-plane needle, anterior to posterior
15–20 mL per side — hydro-dissect the plane

rectus-sheath.name: Gây tê bao cơ thẳng bụng
rectus-sheath.targetNerve: Phân chia trước của T9–T12 (trong bao cơ thẳng)
indications: Midline abdominal surgery (umbilical hernia, midline laparotomy)

pecs-1.name: Gây tê khoang cơ ngực I (PECS I)
pecs-1.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh ngực bên và giữa
technique: US probe parasagittal, infraclavicular
Target plane between pectoralis major and minor (thoracoacromial artery landmark)
Single injection, 10–15 mL

pecs-2.name: Gây tê khoang cơ ngực II (PECS II)
pecs-2.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh ngực bên và trong + dây thần kinh liên sườn T2–T6

volumeMl.split: 10 mL PECS I + 20 mL PECS II

technique: As for PECS I plus second injection between pectoralis minor and serratus anterior
Covers lateral chest wall and axilla

serratus.name: Gây tê mặt phẳng cơ răng trước
serratus.targetNerve: Nhánh da ngoài của dây thần kinh liên sườn T2–T9
technique: Lateral or supine with arm abducted
US probe over 4th–5th ribs in mid-axillary line
Identify latissimus dorsi, serratus anterior, ribs
Two approaches: superficial (between lat dorsi and serratus) or deep (below serratus)
In-plane needle, 20–30 mL

paravertebral.name: Gây tê cạnh cột sống ngực
paravertebral.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh cột sống và chuỗi giao cảm trong khoang cạnh cột sống
indications: When thoracic epidural contraindicated (anticoagulation, spinal surgery)

volumeMl.per_level: 3–5 mL × nhiều mức HOẶC tiêm một lần

paravertebral.coverage: Phong bế thân thể VÀ giao cảm một bên cho nhiều da vùng ngực
technique: Prone or sitting
US probe sagittal, 2.5 cm lateral to spinous process
Identify transverse process, superior costo-transverse ligament, pleura
In-plane needle, approach from cephalad or caudad
Pop through costo-transverse ligament, inject with pleura depressed

esp.name: Gây tê mặt phẳng cơ dựng sống (ESP block)
esp.targetNerve: Các nhánh lưng và bụng của các dây thần kinh cột sống (lan truyền cạnh cột sống từ ESP)
indications: Hip fracture (low ESP at L2-L4 — emerging evidence)
advantages: Safer than paravertebral (no pneumothorax risk, no major vessels)
Anticoagulation concerns less than epidural (but still cautious)
Single injection covers multiple dermatomes (3–6 levels)
sideEffects: Theoretical sympathetic block if large volume
technique: Lateral or prone
US probe sagittal, 2–3 cm lateral to spinous process of target level (e.g. T5 for thoracic, T7 for abdominal)
Identify transverse process, erector spinae muscles
In-plane needle, cephalad to caudad, touch transverse process
Inject below erector spinae, above transverse process — should see craniocaudal spread

qlb.name: Gây tê cơ vuông thắt lưng (QL block)
qlb.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh cột sống thắt lưng T7–L1 (thông qua lan ra cạnh cột sống)
indications: Abdominal surgery (broader than TAP — includes visceral coverage)
Caesarean section (especially with posterior QL or QL3)
technique: Lateral decubitus with operative side up
US probe transverse just above iliac crest
Identify QL muscle lateral to psoas
In-plane needle from lateral approach
Inject in chosen compartment (QL1 = lateral to QL, QL2 = posterior to QL, QL3 = between QL and psoas)

superficial-cervical.name: Gây tê đám rối cổ nông
indications: Carotid endarterectomy (awake technique — combined with deep cervical)
technique: Supine, head turned away
US probe transverse at mid-sternocleidomastoid (SCM)
Target posterior border of SCM, subcutaneous/subfascial plane
Single injection 10–15 mL

caudal.name: Gây tê khoang xương cùng (Caudal block)
caudal.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh tủy sống qua khoang ngoài màng cứng đuôi

volumeMl.formula: Armitage: 0,5 mL/kg (xương cùng), 1 mL/kg (thắt lưng cùng), 1,25 mL/kg (ngực thấp), tối đa 20 mL

maxDoseLBW.bupivacaine: 2 mg/kg LBW (sử dụng 0,25% hoặc 0,125% ở trẻ sơ sinh)

adjuvants: Clonidine 1–2 mcg/kg — prolongs duration by ~4 h (avoid > 2 mcg/kg in neonates due to apnoea risk)
Morphine 30–50 mcg/kg — 12–24 h analgesia (respiratory monitoring required minimum 12 h)
testDoseProtocol: MANDATORY under GA (child cannot report subjective symptoms)
Use 0.1 mL/kg of LA solution with adrenaline 1:200,000 (5 mcg/mL)
Wait 60 seconds. POSITIVE TEST: HR rise ≥ 10 bpm OR systolic BP rise ≥ 15 mmHg OR T-wave amplitude change ≥ 25% (Tobias 2001)
NEGATIVE test does NOT exclude intravascular placement — sevoflurane blunts β-1 response in 25–30%
Aspirate every 3 mL during injection; inject SLOWLY over 60–90 seconds
Ultrasound visualisation of injectate spread is the gold standard where available (Roberts 2005)
monitoring: Continuous ECG, SpO₂, NIBP (cycle q1min × 10 min post-injection then q3 min)
Pupillary check before draping and again 5 min post-injection (mydriasis = cephalad LA spread)
Airway pressure trend (rise suggests high block paralysing intercostals)
Temperature (block-induced vasodilation causes heat loss in small children)
earlyWarningSigns: BRADYCARDIA (commonest first sign under GA — vagal-dominant cardiovascular system)
ECG: widened QRS, prolonged QTc, ST-T changes, new arrhythmia
Rising airway pressure (high block paralysing intercostals)
Non-reactive mydriasis — pathognomonic for total spinal
NO subjective warning symptoms — detection is purely objective
sideEffects: Intravascular injection (sacral canal vessels) → LAST: bradycardia/asystole is the FIRST sign in children, not seizures
Dural puncture → TOTAL SPINAL (dura ends S3–S4 in neonates, S2 in older children; infants more vulnerable)
emergencyResponse: Key paediatric differences: ATROPINE 20 mcg/kg first-line for bradycardia (NOT phenylephrine first)
LAST in paediatric: adrenaline REDUCED 1 mcg/kg (NOT 10 mcg/kg); Intralipid 1.5 mL/kg LBW bolus
Total spinal: intubate, atropine + adrenaline, fluid 20 mL/kg, expect 1–3 h block regression
technique: Lateral decubitus, knees to chest
Palpate sacral hiatus (triangle with posterior superior iliac spines)
Ultrasound preferred for neonates and infants (Mirjalili 2015)
22G short bevel or dedicated caudal needle, 45° angle cephalad
Pop through sacrococcygeal ligament, flatten to 15° and advance 2–3 mm
Confirm with test dose AND ultrasound visualisation of caudal spread where available
caudal.ageLimit: Chủ yếu là trẻ sơ sinh và trẻ em nặng tới 20–25 kg (giải phẫu trở nên kém thuận lợi hơn)
references: Ecoffey C et al. J Clin Anesth 2022;79:110725 (PMID 35313269) — practice advisory on prevention/management of complications
Suresh S et al. Reg Anesth Pain Med 2018;43:211 (PMID 29319604) — ESRA/ASRA paediatric LA dosing
Walker BJ et al. Anesthesiology 2018;129:721 — PRAN registry >100,000 blocks: LAST 0.76:10,000
Tobias JD. Anesth Analg 2001 — test dose criteria under sevoflurane

ilioinguinal.name: Gây tê thần kinh chậu bẹn - chậu hạ vị
ilioinguinal.targetNerve: Dây thần kinh chậu bẹn và hạ vị (L1)
technique: US probe transverse, 1–2 cm medial and caudal to ASIS
Identify three muscle layers: external oblique, internal oblique, transversus
Target plane between internal oblique and transversus abdominis
In-plane needle, small volume
